description: Pink handkerchief embroidered with two Korean women with black hair dressed in kimono-type attire with one figure in red and the other figure in turquoise and pink. The word Korea is embroidered in black on a diagonal below them. The scalloped edges of the handkerchief is embroidered in white thread.
